request.title: Jungle: the drowned world
request.prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. This is a still for a cinematic trailer: keep the main subject centred slightly above the middle with a strong silhouette, and keep the lower third darker and uncluttered so a title can sit over it. Scene: the future where the sea and nature win: the oceans have risen inland and drowned the old towns, and a riot of new jungle has overrun what is left, huge roots and vines wrapping half-sunken towers, strange new creatures in the green water. Beautiful and menacing.
request.alt: Half-sunken towers wrapped in jungle vines in risen sea water, overrun by strange new life.
